answer: Each agent must map a haven in the tundra: the beacon emits a wander seed each epoch, and the agent must chart a unique path. The first step costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent step doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at step 14 (20.4 M iterations). A wander audit verifies each footprint against the epoch seed; any missed step voids the trail. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full map cost because each step binds to the unique identity key—no path sharing possible.
